caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped container or tin with a decorative scene wrapped around its side. The background color of the tin is yellow, with various brown, green, and reddish accents. The scene features a row of buildings with pitched roofs and multiple windows, resembling houses or a village. In front of the buildings, there are several human figures, all dressed in old-fashioned attire such as coats and hats, marching or walking together. Beside them, there is a detailed depiction of a fire engine or a cart with large wheels and the number "13" on its side, being pulled or accompanied by the people. To the right, there are two trees with brown trunks and green-and-yellow leaves, some with white dots possibly representing flowers or fruit. The top rim of the container is bordered with a band of teal blue patterned with white circles and floral shapes. The overall composition is contained by the oval shape, and the background behind the tin is a plain beige color.
title: Bandbox - Firemen Scene
